description: This Java class 'JmsService' models the '<jms-service>' XML element, representing configuration details for a JMS service within the OFBiz framework. It parses XML attributes and child elements to initialize service properties such as name, send mode, and associated servers.

classes.name: JmsService
classes.description: A class representing a JMS service configuration, encapsulating the service's name, send mode, and associated server list, initialized from an XML element.

methods.name: JmsService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the JmsService object by parsing the given XML element, extracting attributes and child elements, and handling potential configuration exceptions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the JMS service.

methods.name: getSendMode
methods.description: Returns the send mode of the JMS service.

methods.name: getServers
methods.description: Returns the list of associated Server objects for this JMS service.
